providers.label: Google Gemini
providers.note: Uses your own Google AI Studio key, free tier.
providers.key_placeholder: Paste your Google AI Studio API key
providers.help:
Get a free Gemini API key (stays in your browser only):
1. Open aistudio.google.com/apikey and sign in.
2. Click Create API key (no billing/card needed).
3. Paste it in the box above. It is saved only in this browser (localStorage) - never uploaded to this site or shared. Clear it anytime by emptying the box.
Free tier uses the Flash models and has per-minute/day limits.

providers.label: Groq
providers.note: Uses your own Groq key, free tier. Long wikis are cut short to fit its limits.
providers.help:
Get a free Groq API key:
1. Open console.groq.com/keys and sign in.
2. Click Create API Key and paste it above. It stays in this browser only.

providers.label: OpenRouter
providers.note: Uses your own OpenRouter key. Many models, some free.
providers.help:
Get an OpenRouter API key:
1. Open openrouter.ai/keys and sign in.
2. Create a key and paste it above. Pick any model name from openrouter.ai/models under Other model.

providers.label: OpenAI
providers.help: Create a key at platform.openai.com/api-keys. It stays in this browser only.

providers.label: Anthropic Claude
providers.help: Create a key at console.anthropic.com. It stays in this browser only.

providers.label: Other (OpenAI-compatible)
providers.note: Any service with an OpenAI-style /chat/completions endpoint - DeepSeek, Mistral, Together, a local LM Studio...
providers.help: Enter the service's API base URL (the part before /chat/completions, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com) and a model name, then your key. The service has to accept requests from websites; most big ones do.
